text: The new government then made one fatal mistake.
And a bald, furious revolutionary named Vladimir Lenin promised Russians exactly what they wanted.
And when do we deliver the peace?
After the Civil War, in October 1917, Lenin's Bolsheviks seized power.
Then came a brutal civil war, Lenin's reds against the anti-communist whites.
Britain, France, America, and Japan all sent troops.
Millions died from fighting, hunger, and disease.
In July 1918, in a cellar in the city of Yekaterinburg, the Bolsheviks shot Nicholas, Alexandra,
their four daughters, their son Alexei, and their servants.
And in 1922, the old empire became a brand new country, the Union of Soviet Socialist
republics. The USSR. Hmm. Collapse? Then a new man promises order? Hmm. You know what comes next.
